 WATCH: Diomande’s Assist Vs Gambia
 by Kiyan Sobhani Nov 13, 2026, 1:49 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 (FROM L) Ivory Coast’s forward #15 Amad Diallo, Ivory Coast’s forward #10 Yan Diomande and Ivory Coast’s forward #12 Elye Wahi celebrate a goal during the Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) Group C qualifying football match between Ivory Coast and Gambia at the Stade de la Paix in Bouake on November 12, 2026. (Photo by Issouf SANOGO / AFP via Getty Images) AFP via Getty Images It was a busy day for Real Madrid internationals, with all of Arda Güler, Yan Diomande, Jude Bellingham, Trent Alexander-Arnold, Eduardo Camavinga, Dean Huijsen, and Marc Cucurella playing with their respective national teams. We broke it all down here in podcast form:
 Earlier today, Diomande and Ivory Coast beat Gambia 2 - 1 in African Cup of Nations Qualifying, in a game in which they thoroughly dominated, even if the scoreline didn’t suggest it.
 Ivory Coast outshot Gambia 21 - 7, and limited their opponents to zero big chances.
 Diomande played the full 90 minutes on the left wing, and produced the assist to Malick Yalcouyé for the team’s second goal:
 In the win, Diomande won four of his ground duels, completed two dribbles, and had three key passes to go along with his assist.
 Ivory Coast play Gambia again on Tuesday, and currently sit at the top of Group C with a maximum nine points.
